about_the_game:
The threads of fate pull you closer to the unknown. As the Tombs of the Erased loom over Eterra, take your first steps into the weave of destiny with the Woven Traveler supporter pack. Whether you're delving into forgotten tombs or charting your path through time, equip yourself with these unique cosmetics that embody mystery and adventure.

Back Slot - Mystic's Arsenal
A weathered cloak adorned with the visual trappings of a wandering mage. The worn staff and well-thumbed wizard’s tome suggest countless journeys and untold tales. Perfect for Travelers who carry the weight of wisdom wherever they roam.

Weapon - 2H Sword - Eternal Rest

This ethereal greatsword cosmetic hums with the faint whispers of souls trapped within its blade. The blue-green hue is a haunting reminder of battles fought and lives claimed—a striking visual for those who seek to channel the echoes of the past.

Weapon - 1h Axe Lyre’s Edge

Grace meets brutality with this exquisite axe cosmetic. Its gold and white design, shaped like the delicate curves of a lyre, masks its deadly purpose. Every swing of the Lyre’s Edge cosmetic is a visual symphony of beauty and destruction.


Pet - Capybara

Your most loyal—and perhaps most adorable—cosmetic companion. Outfitted with side saddlebags, a bedroll, and a sturdy harness, this capybara cosmetic adds a touch of fun and whimsy to your journey.

The Capybara is a unique pet cosmetic that can join you on your journey through Last Epoch.

Evade - Wraithwalker

When death brushes close, leave behind a fleeting trail of necrotic energy with this evade cosmetic. A spectral effect that serves as a haunting reminder of the cost of survival.

Evade - Lightwalker
Radiance follows your every step. The Lightwalker cosmetic evokes shimmering gold light as you evade, a brief but resplendent blessing to guide your path through even the darkest of shadows.

Woven Traveler Forum Badge
You were here for Season 2, and your journey is a part of your story. Showcase your travels with the Woven Traveler Forum Badge.
